en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/44] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father AND Muhammad b. Ismail from al-Fadhl b. Shadhan all together from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil b. Darraj who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: when the soul will reach here – and he pointed with his hand to his throat – there will be no repentance for the scholar
then he recited: “Verily repentance is upon Allāh only for those who work evil in ignorance” [4:17].
